text_block_list.text: After going through the Kikuka-sho, a change had come over Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyah... y-yesh!?
I-It's Rice... Rice Shower...!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so nervous!
Hehe, you were amazing at the Kikuka Sho the other day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That showdown with Bourbon-san...
It was seriously electrifying!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! Man, Bourbon-san back then...
Ngh~...! She was super serious and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! That's right... Bourbon-san is...
strong, cool, and...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So keep giving it your all! 
I'll be rooting for you too, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!?
Y... Yeah!!
choice_data_list: It's nice to know they're rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all... They only called out to me
because you're so amazing, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Even the applause at the Kikuka-sho was only because Bourbon-san was there...
choice_data_list: Because you were there too, as my rival
Because you, my rival, were there too

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... Even you're flattering me
too much, Onii-sama...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... Even you're flattering me
too much, Onee-sama...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, a rival, huh? Hehe.
—However, the next day, the situation completely changed.
(Whisper, whisper...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Don't come any closer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess Rice-san...
really let it get to her after all."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well... that makes sense.
I wouldn't want that either.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I mean, imagine that infallible Bourbon-san... right after racing with you, and all."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*... Why does it...
always end up like this for Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I only ever bring misfortune to everyone around me, nothing but trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... !?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No, you can't! If you get close to Rice,
you'll become unhappy too!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter how hard the training was,
Bourbon-san has never... gotten injured before...
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's all Rice's fault...
Just because you became Rice's rival...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The most crucial period in the three years is ruined...
choice_data_list: Did you hear that directly from them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you don't say it, I know.
Because... Rice is..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? B... Big Brother!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? B... Big Sister!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Forgive me for reaching out so abruptly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, I've gotten used to having people visit me over the past day, so it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So, what can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! ...I-I'm sorry.
I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because of Rice... you got hurt
and lost such an important time...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing? I deduce that there is no causal relationship between my injury and you, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... getting injured like that
before we even become rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Incomprehensible. The injury rate is constant.
Therefore, that theory is deemed to have zero physical basis.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you insist so strongly that you bring misfortune,
then I believe you should put it to the test with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have come to recognize you as my rival.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's because I had high hopes.
In the potential for growth that I felt at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Having you as a rival
means I can look forward to even greater growth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"And the 'miraculous' possibility
of running the greatest race in history with you."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you're truly connected to my misfortune, Rice,
wouldn't that only be if I hadn't been able to run that race?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you a presence that brings me misfortune, Rice-san?
Or are you one that brings miracles?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's...
—For a while, she silently held Mihono Bourbon's gaze.
